question: How is sectionsWithProjectsCollapsed prepared, which members are removed, and when does a normal populated list use it?

confirmed.claim: The collapsed array producer is 0x32c270. It first searches for the exact .projectsTitle ID. Without that ID it retains/returns its input array unchanged.
locations: 0x32c2b8..0x32c2ec all other ID payload words zero

confirmed.claim: When Projects title exists, producer traverses all sections in original order, classifies the ID to common header kind, and excludes kind1. It preserves complete descriptors for surviving sections.
Excluded IDs are noWorkspace(raw1), remoteWorkspace(raw3), remoteProject(raw4). Their host scope and position do not exempt them. This includes No workspace in the Projects total-collapse behavior.

Title(raw0), remoteHost(raw2), remoteCustomSection(raw5) are kind0 and survive. The no-payload tag6 cases Projects title, searchResults, remoteProjectlessThreads survive. Projects title and remoteProjectlessThreads map to kind2, searchResults maps to kind0.
locations: other valid no-payload case payload2 ->0x32c48c kind2

confirmed.claim: A request-state setter produces this prepared array when the extracted section-array value changes. It obtains the current available value, falls back to empty array when nil, calls32c270, then writes through the collapsed-array setter. Collapse toggling itself can therefore select an existing projection.
The owner obtains normal request state from getter32c210 and the prepared array from32a8b8. It stores them at owner+8 and owner+0x18 respectively.

In the normal available-list branch, a nonempty search after trimming whitespacesAndNewlines bypasses Projects collapse. With empty trimmed search, getter is called with exact.projectsTitle; true chooses owner+0x18, false returns the normal available array.

minimally_implementable_projection.input: An existing ordered [TaskSection] with genuine typed section IDs.
minimally_implementable_projection.preservation: Keep surviving full descriptors, order, full host/section identities and row contents. Do not regroup, reorder, merge hosts, or nest folders beneath Projects.
minimally_implementable_projection.normal_list_gate: After normal available request-state selection, use the prepared projection iff searchQuery.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty && taskSectionIsCollapsed(.projectsTitle).
minimally_implementable_projection.header_direct_content: From v500, the standalone Projects header also gates its own projectCatalogRequests rows by its isCollapsed state. That is an additional existing direct-content rule, separate from the whole-list projection.
minimally_implementable_projection.projects_insertion: Use independently recovered v500 grouping/insertion rule. A populated workspace/project set can establish insertion even with no catalog requests. Do not create Projects unconditionally.

independent_expected_vectors.reason: Remove raw tags1/3/4 everywhere, preserve other original order
Both host-scoped No workspace sections removed, including before Projects

unknown_or_out_of_scope: No target-app runtime execution or independent replay was performed for this evidence batch. Expected vectors are static-derived test specifications.

Broader empty-state substitute selection before398f9c (homeEmptyState raw3, request-state unavailable combinations and39902c) is outside this normal populated-list result. Preserve existing behavior rather than reinterpreting those gates.
Project catalog host eligibility and ordering still have v500 boundaries. They are not required to prove the full-list exclusion predicate.

Field offset storage0xb0c8cd8 is directly tied to the owner collapsed-array getter. Initial exploratory scans of static metadata pattern offset slots yielded no adjacent references and are not evidence of absence.
Typed enum cases and exact payload checks apply to valid official values. Unknown binary enum tags must not be treated as supported.
